Calculation Details

MetricValueNote

How it works

Estimate wheel offset from wheel width and backspacing. Use the units shown in the calculator and review every assumption before using the result.

Formula

Offset (mm) ≈ (backspacing − nominal wheel centerline) × 25.4.

Worked example

A wider backspacing measurement generally moves the mounting face outward relative to wheel centerline.

Important assumptions

This tool is designed for planning and comparison. Real-world prices, manufacturer ratings, building requirements, lender terms, electrical codes, tolerances, and product specifications can vary.
